notes: The arm-swing leg test no longer moves on a single glitched frame — the thigh-separation number is now a sustained range, confirmed by at least two frames, like the rest of the two-camera numbers already are. One frame misreading a knee wide used to report a real arm-swing drill as a sprint with a 100 arm-travel score. A real sprint swings the thighs wide on every stride, so it still reads as a sprint.
